name: EV Electric Services

business_description_schema: Residential electrical contractor serving Fairfax County, VA and the Northern Virginia / DC / Montgomery County MD region. Master electrician, fully insured, troubleshooting-led.
review_pitch: Our review base is real, recent, and from Northern Virginia homeowners. We don't ghost-write reviews or recycle them across business directories.
brand_extended_coverage_phrase: We also cover DC and Montgomery County, MD (Rockville, Bethesda, Chevy Chase, Potomac).
owner_bio_paragraphs: Ahmad is a Master Electrician licensed in Virginia. The Master tier is the highest electrician license the state issues — it requires several years of journeyman work, a passed state exam, and a clean record. Ahmad waited roughly four years for his Master license before opening EV Electric Services. He's fully insured and runs a maintenance team, so when you call us you're not waiting on one person's calendar.

Ahmad is the person who shows up at most residential {service_lowercase} calls. He's the diagnostician — the one who reads the panel, runs the tests, and explains what's happening. His preference is to find the root cause and repair it once, rather than patch the symptom and come back next month.
final_cta_response_promise: We respond within one business day.
